summary: A generative firmware built on Felucca that composes endlessly in the manner of a chosen composer or popular genre, using a port of Mutable Instruments Marbles shaped by music theory.
features: 89 composers and styles across 10 eras; 86 genres from the 1950s on
95 instruments on Felucca's engines; only the piano is sampled
Historical tunings, odd meters, and a 'MOOD' knob from calm to busy
Freeze into an editable pattern of up to 384 notes; 16 save slots
Share codes, favourites and a radio mode that changes pieces
MIDI out with a channel per part; MIDI clock in and out
